zh: 修复数据抓取页「运行批脚本」后自动打开的数据导入页文件变少：站点打开后自己刷新或登录跳转会丢掉下载拦截，现在每个任务前都会重新装上；桌面版还会把运行标签真实下载完成的 CSV 补传给导入页，同名文件只保留一份。
修复数据导入后桌面版长时间卡顿、打开数据导入页持续占用资源：顶部指标栏自动滚动不再每帧触发全局「回到顶部」按钮重新布局；历史快照摘要列表与单份快照更新不再把全部快照整份解析到内存（50 份快照时内存峰值从约 1.4 GB 降到十几 MB）；桌面版新增窗口无响应与主进程阻塞日志，便于定位卡顿。
en: Fixed the auto-opened data import page missing files after Run batch on the data capture page: the download capture lost when a site reloads or redirects for login is now re-installed before every task, and the desktop app also forwards CSV files the run tab actually downloaded, keeping one copy per file name.

Fixed long desktop freezes after data import and the data import page draining resources: the auto-scrolling metric bar no longer makes the global back-to-top button re-layout on every frame; the snapshot summary list and single-snapshot updates no longer parse every saved snapshot in memory (peak memory with 50 snapshots drops from about 1.4 GB to under 20 MB); the desktop app now logs unresponsive windows and main-process stalls.
